description: I fixed the initialization mapping bug in the `Block` class (specifically assigning `self.x` and `self.x0` to the forward pass parameters `self.resid_lambdas` instead of the class dictionary attributes `self.resid_lambdas`), which caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to crash on the first step due to empty tensors. This resulted in a loss drop from 0.9947 to 0.9912 (val_bpb=0.9910), which was the best performance achieved in the history of this specific run.
